content_sections.heading: TNAU Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the TNAU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download TNAU Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: TNAU Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 12 vacancies are available - 1 for Young Professional I, 3 for Senior Research Fellow, 7 for Junior Research Fellow and 2 for Technical Assistant (Field).

content_sections.heading: TNAU Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Young Professional I: Four year Bachelor's Degree B.Sc. (Agriculture) Senior Research Fellow: M.Sc. (Agri.) in Plant Pathology Junior Research Fellow: Four year Bachelor's Degree B.Sc. (Agriculture / Horticulture) Technical Assistant (Field): Diploma in the required field (Agriculture / Horticulture) Senior Research Fellow: M.Sc. (Horticulture) / M.Sc. (Agri) in Biotechnology / M.Sc. (Agri) in Molecular Biology and Biotechnology

content_sections.heading: TNAU Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Young Professional I: Rs. 30,000/- p.m. Senior Research Fellow: Rs. 37,000/- p.m. First two years and Rs. 42,000/- p.m. for Third year Junior Research Fellow: Rs. 30,000/- p.m. Technical Assistant (Field): Rs. 20,000/- p.m. (As per ASO) Technical Assistant (Field): Rs. 23,000/- p.m. Senior Research Fellow: Rs. 31,000/- p.m.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced by TNAU?
faq.answer: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University (TNAU) has announced a total of 12 vacancies for various posts including Young Professional I, Senior Research Fellow, Junior Research Fellow, and Technical Assistant (Field).

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for TNAU recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the TNAU posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by post and include degrees like B.Sc. (Agriculture/Horticulture), M.Sc. (Agri.) in Plant Pathology, M.Sc. (Horticulture), M.Sc. (Agri) in Biotechnology, M.Sc. (Agri) in Molecular Biology and Biotechnology, and Diploma in Agriculture/Horticulture.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the TNAU positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 20,000/- to Rs. 42,000/- per month, depending on the specific post and experience.

faq.question: Q5. When are the walk-in interviews scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are scheduled on 28 August 2026, 1 September 2026, and 3 September 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for TNAU recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, ID proof, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The official notification should be referred to for the exact venue address for the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions are contractual in nature.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Tamil Nadu apply?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any domicile restrictions, but candidates should check the official notification for any such requirements.
